title: Towards Fair and Explainable AI using a Human-Centered AI Approach
findings: The Word2vec word embedding model, trained on the Google News corpus, exhibited significant biases. It strongly associated the 'Islam' subgroup with words like 'terrorist', 'terror', 'dictator', and 'militia', especially in intersectional contexts (e.g., Muslim males). The 'Christianity' subgroup was associated with words like 'nazi' (in the context of Male, White, Poor) and also with words like 'romantic', 'nuns', and 'career' depending on the other intersecting identities.
